SELECT b.id processId, b.`name`, a.complete_quantity, a.inspection_quantity, a.userNames FROM ( SELECT mp.process_id, mp.sequence, SUM( ifnull(report.quantity,0)) complete_quantity, SUM( ifnull(report.inspection_quantity,0)) inspection_quantity, group_concat(distinct tulink.user_name) AS userNames FROM mes_building_task_process mp LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report report on report.task_process_id = mp.id and report.task_type_enum = #{type} and report.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link tulink on tulink.team_id = report.team_id and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.bool_leader_enum = 1 WHERE mp.product_id = #{id} AND mp.task_type_enum = #{type} AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY mp.process_id, mp.sequence ORDER BY mp.sequence ) AS a LEFT JOIN mes_building_process b ON b.id = a.process_id AND b.bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT b.id processId, b.`name`, a.complete_quantity, a.inspection_quantity, a.userNames FROM ( SELECT distinct mp.process_id, mp.sequence, SUM( mp.complete_quantity ) complete_quantity, SUM( mp.inspection_quantity ) inspection_quantity, group_concat(distinct users.name) AS userNames FROM tech_artifact artifact LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process mp on artifact.id = mp.product_id AND mp.task_type_enum = #{type} LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report report on report.task_process_id = mp.id and report.task_type_enum = #{type} and report.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user users on users.id = report.user_id WHERE artifact.serial_number = #{serialNumber} and artifact.monomer_id = #{monomerId} and artifact.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY mp.process_id, mp.sequence ORDER BY sequence ) AS a LEFT JOIN mes_building_process b ON b.id = a.process_id AND b.bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT b.`name`, SUM( a.inspection_quantity) complete_quantity FROM mes_building_produce_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_process b ON a.process_id = b.id WHERE a.product_id=#{id} AND a.product_type=#{type}
AND date(a.create_time) >=date(#{startDate})
AND date(a.create_time) <=date(#{endDate})

SELECT a.id, -- 产品id
-- 未生产 a.quantity - ifnull(in_production_quantity,0) AS quantity, a.net_weight * (a.quantity - ifnull(in_production_quantity,0)) AS total_net_weight, -- 总净重, a.gross_weight * (a.quantity - ifnull(in_production_quantity,0)) AS total_gross_weight, -- 总毛重,

-- 生产完毕、已入库、已收货 ifnull(complete_quantity ,0) AS quantity, a.net_weight * ifnull(complete_quantity ,0) AS total_net_weight, -- 总净重, a.gross_weight * ifnull(complete_quantity ,0) AS total_gross_weight, -- 总净重,
-- 未入库、未收货 a.quantity - IFNULL(complete_quantity,0) AS quantity, a.net_weight * (a.quantity - IFNULL(complete_quantity,0)) AS total_net_weight, -- 总净重, a.gross_weight * (a.quantity - IFNULL(complete_quantity,0)) AS total_gross_weight, -- 总毛重,
-- 已出库、已安装 ifnull(in_production_quantity ,0) AS quantity, a.net_weight * ifnull(in_production_quantity ,0) AS total_net_weight, -- 总净重, a.gross_weight * ifnull(in_production_quantity ,0) AS total_gross_weight, -- 总毛重,
a.quantity, -- 清单数量 a.total_gross_weight, -- 清单总毛重 a.total_net_weight, -- 清单总净重,
a.gross_weight, a.net_weight, a.serial_number, -- 构件编号 a.name, -- 构件名称 IFNULL(bTwo.in_production_quantity, 0 ) AS in_production_quantity, -- 进入生产数量 、出库数量、安装数量 IFNULL(complete_quantity, 0 ) complete_quantity -- 完成生产数量、入库数量、收货数量 FROM tech_artifact a
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, IFNULL( SUM( a.in_production_quantity ), 0 ) AS in_production_quantity, -- 进入生产数量 IFNULL( SUM( a.complete_quantity ), 0 ) AS complete_quantity -- 完成生产数量 FROM mes_building_task a WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND a.task_type_enum = #{productType} GROUP BY a.product_id ) bTwo ON a.id = bTwo.product_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, IFNULL(sum(quantity), 0 ) AS complete_quantity -- 入库数量 FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary a WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND a.product_type = #{productType} and type = 1 GROUP BY a.product_id ) bOne ON a.id = bOne.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, IFNULL( sum(quantity), 0 ) AS in_production_quantity -- 出库数量 FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary a WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND a.product_type = #{productType} and type = 2 GROUP BY a.product_id ) bTwo ON a.id = bTwo.product_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, IFNULL(sum(quantity), 0 ) AS complete_quantity -- 收货数量 FROM project_receiving_summary a WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND a.product_type = #{productType} GROUP BY a.product_id ) bOne ON a.id = bOne.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, IFNULL(sum(actual_quantity), 0 ) AS in_production_quantity -- 安装数量 FROM project_install_summary a WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND a.product_type = #{productType} GROUP BY a.product_id ) bTwo ON a.id = bTwo.product_id
a.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
AND a.monomer_id = #{monomerId}
and a.area_id in
#{areaId}

#{id}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(task.create_time,'%Y-%m') date, shop.id workShopId, shop.name workShopName, sum(task.task_quantity) taskQuantity, sum(task.task_quantity * art.net_weight) netWeightSum FROM mes_building_task task LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON task.product_id = art.id left join mes_building_workshop shop on task.workshop_id = shop.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 where task.bool_delete_enum = 0 and task.task_type_enum = 2 and DATE_FORMAT(task.create_time,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(task.create_time,'%Y-%m'), shop.id

SELECT tulink.team_id, tulink.user_name teamLeaderName, DATE_FORMAT( pro.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) date, IFNULL( sum( pro.task_quantity * art.net_weight ), 0 ) taskQuantitySum, IFNULL( sum( rep.quantity * art.net_weight ), 0 ) completeQuantitySum FROM mes_building_task_process pro INNER JOIN mes_building_team_user_link tulink ON pro.team_id = tulink.team_id AND tulink.bool_leader_enum = 1 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON pro.product_id = art.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report rep ON pro.task_id = rep.task_id AND DATE_FORMAT( pro.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( rep.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) WHERE pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND rep.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pro.task_type_enum = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT( pro.create_time, '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{time}, '%Y' )
and pro.team_id in
#{teamId}
GROUP BY tulink.team_id, tulink.user_name, DATE_FORMAT( pro.create_time, '%Y-%m' )

SELECT tnlink.artifact_id artId, ass.id productId, ass.serial_number, ass.specification, ass.length, ass.material, count(tnlink.assemble_number) quantity, IFNULL(sum( rep.quantity ),0) producedQuantity, tulink.user_name teamLeaderName FROM mes_building_task_number_link tnlink LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ass ON tnlink.assemble_id = ass.id AND ass.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process pro ON tnlink.assemble_task_id = pro.task_id AND pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_produce_team_report rep on tnlink.assemble_task_id = rep.task_id and tnlink.assemble_number = rep.number and rep.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link tulink ON pro.team_id = tulink.team_id AND tulink.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE tnlink.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pro.task_type_enum = 16
and tnlink.artifact_id in
#{productId}
GROUP BY tnlink.artifact_id, ass.id, tulink.user_name

SELECT ROUND(SUM( task.complete_quantity * art.net_weight )/1000) totalNetWeight FROM mes_building_task task LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON task.product_id = art.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE task.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND date_format (task.create_time, #{format}) = date_format(#{date}, #{format}) AND task.task_type_enum = 2
AND task.workshop_id = #{workShopId}

SELECT SUM(task.complete_quantity) totalCompleteQuantity FROM mes_building_task task LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON task.product_id = art.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE task.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND date_format (task.create_time, #{format}) = date_format(#{date}, #{format}) AND task.task_type_enum = 2
AND task.workshop_id = #{workShopId}

SELECT ifnull(sum( task.task_quantity ),0) oneQuantity, ifnull(sum( task.complete_quantity ),0) twoQuantity FROM mes_building_task task LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON task.product_id = art.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE task.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND YEAR ( task.create_time ) = '2024' AND task.task_type_enum = 2
AND task.workshop_id = #{workShopId}

select a.* from (
SELECT taskProcess.task_id, report.in_year_month_day_date AS createTime, mtask.workshop_id AS partWorkshopId, partWorkshop.NAME AS produceWorkshopName, report.workshop_id AS reportWorkshopId, useWorkshop.NAME AS workshopName, cp.name AS 'project.Name', cp.serial_number AS 'project.serialNumber', cp.short_name AS 'project.shortName', part.relation_type, part.NAME, part.serial_number, part.length, part.material, sum( report.quantity * partLink.quantity ) AS quantity, part.specification, part.net_weight, part.gross_weight, sum( partLink.quantity * report.quantity * part.net_weight ) AS totalNetWeight, sum( partLink.quantity * report.quantity * part.net_weight ) AS totalGrossWeight, taskProcess.task_type_enum FROM mes_building_task_process taskProcess LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = taskProcess.project_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report report ON report.task_process_id = taskProcess.id INNER JOIN mes_building_machine_part_scheduling_artifact_task_link taskLink ON taskLink.task_id = taskProcess.task_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_machine_part_scheduling_link schedulingLink ON schedulingLink.id = taskLink.scheduling_link_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task mtask ON mtask.product_id = schedulingLink.product_id AND mtask.machine_part_scheduling_id = schedulingLink.scheduling_id AND mtask.task_type_enum = 1
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact_machine_part_link partLink ON partLink.artifact_id = report.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble_machine_part_link partLink ON partLink.assemble_id = report.product_id
AND report.task_type_enum = #{relationType} AND partLink.machine_part_id = schedulingLink.product_id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part part ON part.id = partLink.machine_part_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop partWorkshop ON mtask.workshop_id = partWorkshop.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop useWorkshop ON report. workshop_id = useWorkshop.id WHERE taskProcess.sequence = 0 AND taskProcess.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND taskProcess.task_type_enum = #{relationType} AND taskProcess.complete_quantity > 0 AND mtask.workshop_id != report.workshop_id
AND part.serial_number LIKE CONCAT('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
AND taskProcess.project_id = #{projectId}
AND report.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND report.in_year_month_day_date >= date_format(#{dateTimeList[0]}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND report.in_year_month_day_date <= date_format(#{dateTimeList[1]}, '%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY report.in_year_month_day_date, taskProcess.task_id, mtask.workshop_id, report.workshop_id, cp.id, part.relation_type, part.id, part.serial_number, part.length, part.material, part.specification ) a
